build_NormSoftmaxLoss: build a NormSoftmaxLoss module that computes symmetric softmax loss on a cosine similarity matrix with configurable temperature
build_EgoNCE: build an EgoNCE loss module that computes masked contrastive loss using noun and verb masks with temperature scaling
build_MaxMarginRankingLoss: build a MaxMarginRankingLoss module that computes margin-based ranking loss on a similarity matrix with optional diagonal exclusion
build_AdaptiveMaxMarginRankingLoss: build an AdaptiveMaxMarginRankingLoss module that computes weighted margin ranking loss using per-sample weights on a similarity matrix
build_CrossEntropy: build a CrossEntropy loss wrapper module that computes standard cross-entropy loss between output logits and target labels
